newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Lippo Life says H1 net up sharply-report.
newsitem.headline: Lippo Life says H1 net up sharply-report.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Lippo Life posted a net profit of 65.8 billion rupiah in the first half of 1997, against 14 billion rupiah in the same period in 1996, the Jakarta Post quoted company officials as saying.
Lippo Life president director Billy Sindoro was quoted as saying that the company expected to book a net profit of 150 billion rupiah for the full 1997 year, compared to 66 billion rupiah in 1996.
Sindoro said the company's operating profit in the first six months of the year was up to 69.8 billion rupiah from 13.7 billion rupiah in the same 1996 period.
He said total revenue in the first half of 1997 was also up to 453.5 billion rupiah from 304.3 billion rupiah against the 1996 period.
